shortDescription: India halved import taxes on crude palm and soybean oils to ease local prices heading into the festive season, according to Bloomberg.The move comes as the country, the world's top edible-oil buyer, seeks to reduce food costs for consumers.

title: India Cuts Edible-Oil Import Duties Ahead of Festive Season
